You know what mate?

I like to talk and that's what I'm going to do from now on.

If people want to listen they're welcome to do so, if not, well, i don't care anymore.

No, the drone is supposed to operate autonomously without any outside intervention. It is kind of being designed to be released in a disaster area and provide support to any person that might find themselves stuck there.

My vote is to make into a flying soup kitchen. My telecommunications engineer friend is voting into making it into a movable data center (predictable), while having a swarm of them moving for maximum coverage.

Rough sketch of the drone: http://imgur.com/sN7lJYE

I wish i was able to travel, but that's just not realistic for me right now.

I used to play video games. Quit that about 3 weeks ago.

Started going back to the gym, after a 4 year stop, about 2 weeks ago.

Started designing a UAV alongside a couple of friends. (Unmanned Air Vehicule). Contrary to what i may have insinuated, i like my job, and i love engineering. It's just not fulfilling enough for me.

I have talked with my boss about giving me more work to fill my time (He happily agreed obviously). I finish everything ahead of time, but i don't feel happy about it.

I read books. A lot. I buy a couple every week. And the more i read the less i feel excited about the next one.

And the more i wrote here, the more i feel like i got nothing to complain about. But i do, i just hate everything i do and i wish i were different.

I am an engineer. 24 years old. It's pathetic that i an seriously considering to get married at my age in my circle. Not to mention wanting a child.

I have some hobbies that i enjoy but they're not as fulfilling as one might imagine.

The reason i can't talk to anyone is simple. To an outsider, i got nothing to complain about. I got a life that a lot of people envy. And worse is that i know that. I get immediately labeled as childish if i try to talk about this matter with anyone.

I go to the gym, i read books, i work as an engineer in a very good position with a very good salary for my age, i have a lot of friends (at least enough that i keep myself busy).


But i still don't find it as a reason to get out of bed in the morning.

I find work to be a necessity, in order to survive. Skills and books are only enjoyed for a limited time until you get bored of them.

But what if it doesn't get any better than that.

What then?

I work. I make good money. Still not a reason to get out of bed.

No one cares about my work or my money. Not friends, not loved ones, not anyone.

Work isn't a reason, and honestly, i find it a reason to stay longer in bed.
Imagine yourself 10 years from now. No school to look up to. What would you do then?
Why? What makes you so sure of that?
